At our Utility Coal Mining segment, operated by North American Coal, full-year 2026 operating profit is expected to increase over 2025.
This increase is driven by anticipated improvements at MLMC if the customer's power plant is able to operate more consistently, as well as continued stable earnings at our unconsolidated operations.
We are building a portfolio of long-term contracts through geographic and mineral expansion that are expected to strengthen the foundation for sustained profitability in this segment.

As a result of earnings contributions from new long-term contracts, we anticipate substantial year-over-year growth in Contract Mining operating profit and Segment Adjusted EBITDA in both the fourth-quarter and full-year 2026.
We expect continued Contract Mining operating profit growth in 2027, which will include a full year of contributions from the Palm Beach County, Florida and Arizona quarry contracts.

We expect fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 operating profit and Segment Adjusted EBITDA at Minerals and Royalties to decline from the respective prior-year periods, primarily as a result of lower anticipated royalty income, partially offset by higher expected income from Eiger Resources.
We expect the business to move toward more consistent and improving results over time as its portfolio of mitigation projects matures.
We remain confident in our ability to deliver improving results and increasing cash flow over time.
We expect meaningful year-over-year improvements in operating profit, net income and Consolidated EBITDA in 2027.
Looking ahead, our recent investments are expected to support sustained earnings growth and stronger cash flow as they mature.
We anticipate investing up to $32 million during the remainder of 2026 and up to $56 million in 2027.
Growth investments will be made only if new project proposals meet our disciplined investment criteria.

While cash generated from operations is expected to increase moderately year over year, cash flow before financing is projected to remain a use of cash in 2026, reflecting our planned investment activity.
We expect the full-year 2026 use of cash before financing to improve modestly over 2025.
This development, along with a favorable regulatory environment, reinforces our confidence in our near-term outlook and long-term growth trajectory.
With a perspective that spans decades, we are methodically building a strong, stable business that is expected to deliver annuity-like returns.
We remain confident in our ability to drive growth, expand our capabilities and reward shareholders over the long run.
